notes: v658 - Climbers Today no longer says 'strength 2.1 of 2.0', which read like a score beating its own maximum. The number was right and the wording was wrong: 2.0 is the bar a line has to CLEAR, not a ceiling, so 2.1 has already passed it. What the line never explained was why something that has passed both published tests is still in the nursery. There is a third test it did not mention - the money test added in v577: a line can be statistically beyond doubt and still earn under $0.50 per $100, which brokerage and the spread eat, so it is deliberately held back rather than badged. The label now reads 'strength 2.1 checked, past 2.0 - but it earns under $0.50 per $100, which brokerage eats', and that reason is worked out from the line's actual recorded edge rather than assumed - if the edge is fine, it says so instead of inventing a cause. Display only; no scores, tiers or rules changed. Hard-refresh (Ctrl+F5).
